All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
AISortUtility
This class: - Provides AI-assisted sorting for Shape3D arrays - Sends numeric values to an external Python script for sorting - Receives a sorted index order and rearranges the array accordingly - Falls back to Merge Sort if the AI script fails or returns invalid data
AppDriver
This class: - Acts as the main entry point for the sorting application - Reads command-line arguments for file name, comparison type, and sort type - Loads shapes from a file into a repository - Selects the correct comparator and sorting algorithm - Measures sorting time and prints summary results

Cylinder
 
HeightComparator
This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their height - Sorts in descending order (taller shapes come first)
NameComparator
This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their name - Sorts in ascending alphabetical order (A → Z)

Pyramid
 
Shape3D
 
ShapeLoader
This class: - Loads Shape3D objects from a text file - Creates the correct shape type based on the file input - Stores all loaded shapes inside a ShapeRepository - Skips blank lines and comment lines beginning with '#'
ShapeRepository
This class: - Stores Shape3D objects inside a fixed‑size array - Tracks how many shapes have been added - Provides access to the stored shapes - Allows replacing the entire collection when needed
ShapeResults
This class: - Displays selected results from a sorted Shape3D array - Prints the first, last, and every 1000th element - Shows the comparison value used for sorting (height, volume, or surface area) - Reports the total runtime of the sorting algorithm
SortController
This class: - Selects which sorting algorithm to use - Calls the appropriate SortUtility method based on the user's input - Acts as a controller between the UI and the sorting logic
SortUtility
This class: - Provides multiple sorting algorithms for Shape3D arrays - Sorts shapes in descending order based on the given Comparator - Contains only static methods (no objects of this class are created)
SquarePrism
 
SurfaceAreaCompartor
This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their surface area - Sorts in descending order (larger surface area comes first)
TestAISort
This class: - Demonstrates how the AI sorting system works - Creates a small sample array of Shape3D objects - Prints the array before and after AI sorting - Sorts the shapes by height in descending order using AI Sort
TriangularPyramid
 
VolumeComparator
This class: - Compares two Shape3D objects based on their volume - Sorts in descending order (larger volume comes first)
